name: Azy Agent
welcome: Ask about Azy Board or ask for help with a task.
adjustPlaceholder: Describe what should change before approval...
pasteHint: Text and CSV can be pasted
runFailed: The run failed. You can try again.
rateLimit: Too many messages in a row. Wait a few seconds and try again.
concurrencyLimit: An agent run is already in progress. Wait for it to finish before sending another.
quotaExceeded: Daily agent budget reached. Try again tomorrow.
assistantUnavailable: The agent is not enabled for this tenant. Configure the provider in settings.
toolUnavailable: The agent could not load that capability right now. It can try another approach.
contextMismatch: The selected resource changed. Refresh the context and try again.
capabilityUnavailable: That capability is not available in the agent yet. You can continue from the corresponding Azy Board screen.
completedWithoutMessage: The run completed without an additional message.
messageTooLong: The message is too large. Reduce or split it to at most 30,000 bytes.
actionLimit: This request requires too many actions for one run. Split it into batches of at most 40 actions.
repeatedToolCall: The agent repeated a query and could not finish. Try again.
stepLimit: The agent reached the step limit. Ask an administrator to increase the tenant's maxSteps parameter.
toolCallLimit: The agent reached the tool limit. Ask an administrator to increase the tenant's maxToolCalls parameter.
tokenLimit: The agent reached the token limit. Ask an administrator to increase the tenant's maxInputTokens or maxOutputTokens parameter.
runTimeout: The agent took longer than allowed. Ask an administrator to increase the tenant's timeoutMs parameter.
availabilityHelp: Available only when at least one model is enabled and validated.
pending: Configure and validate at least one model
oauthUnsupported: OAuth/token plan is not compatible with the model API in this environment.
securityNote: Credentials are never displayed or sent to the browser.
governanceHelp: Control model consumption and execution capacity for this tenant. The backend enforces safe ranges.
modelsHelp: List order defines priority. If a provider fails, the next enabled model is tried.
noModelsHelp: Add a model and validate the connection to make Azy Agent available.
removeModelConfirm: Remove {{model}} from the agent's list? Its credential will be revoked if no other model uses it.
secretKeepExisting: Leave blank to keep the current key
modelFormHelp: Test the provider and model before saving. The key is encrypted on the server.
fallbackPrivacyNote: Keys are stored encrypted; the list only shows a masked prefix.
connectionInvalid: The connection could not be validated.
scopeAll: Current result: all cards (no filter) — the action applies to everyone
viewCommandFailed: Could not apply the view command in this tab.

visibilityReasons.ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have access to this card.
visibilityReasons.MODULE_TAB: The card belongs to another module, outside the active tab.
visibilityReasons.EMPTY_GROUP_HIDDEN: The card's group is hidden because it is empty after the filters.
visibilityReasons.COLLAPSED_GROUP: The card is inside a collapsed group.
visibilityReasons.UNKNOWN: Could not determine the reason from the current state.

revealOffer: Want me to show this card? The previous view can be restored.
focusAmbiguity: There is more than one possible item (checklist, link or work log). Which one should I use?
